text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — hosted-runtime: multiple KV cache OOMs detected in shard pool (hosts: shard-12, shard-13) starting ~2026-03-15T02:13Z. Error signature: 'kvcache: allocate failed, OOM'. Triggered after deploy deploy-2026-03-15a. Paging on-call.

maya: I'm oncall — investigating. @sam can you join? seeing continuous-batching counters spike to 600% of baseline on shard-12.

sam: joining. grabbing logs now. suspect continuous-batching config change in last deploy. quick check: /deploys/deploy-2026-03-15a: batch.max_inflight=2048 -> was 512 previously.

lia: noted customer-facing alerts on monitoring. Latency and error rate up for a subset of sessions hitting long-context prompts (>120k tokens). Some clients getting 502s.

maya: timeline: spikes start at 02:13, OOMs at 02:14-02:16, autoscaler tried to spin new hosts but they also hit OOM on attach. Looks like kvmap growth inside runtime, not just host memory.

sam: reproducing locally with a long prompt test. continuous-batcher is coalescing many long sessions into huge batches. KV cache is retaining massive KV sets and not evicting fast enough.

john_runtime: quick note — we have a prefetch controller that was tweaked in the deploy to be more aggressive for throughput. That likely increased KV cardinality. Reverting prefetch aggressiveness should reduce growth.

maya: mitigation plan:
- reduce batch.max_inflight to 256 in runtime-config for hosted-rt (hotfix)
- disable aggressive prefetch for sessions over 64k tokens
- apply session-level prefetch cap: prefetch.max_keys=8192
- enable immediate eviction pressure (kv.eviction.force=true)
- fallback route: route heavy sessions to smaller model variant (llm-medium) for now

sam: running patch now. command:
```
# patch runtime config in k8s configmap
kubectl -n hosted-runtime patch configmap runtime-config --type=json -p='[
  {"op":"replace","path":"/batch.max_inflight","value":"256"},
  {"op":"replace","path":"/prefetch.max_aggression","value":"0.2"}
]'
```

ops-runner: deploy bot: started rollout of runtime-config-hotfix to pool hosted-rt-prod-1 -> canary on shard-12.

lia: monitoring metrics: batch_size_p95 dropping from 1800 -> 200 on canary, kv_map_size trend reversing on canary. Error rate on shard-12 decreasing.

maya: patch looks effective on canary. initiating global rollout to remaining pools with throttled concurrency (1 pool / 30s).

incidents-bot: NOTE: customer impact: ~0.3% of requests in last 15m saw 5xx errors. Potentially affected customers: corpA (high-volume long contexts), api-beta-3. Sending CS an update.

sam: also applied runtime flag to temporarily disable continuous batching for sessions that exceed 80k tokens:
```
runtime.flags.disable_continuous_batching_for_long_sessions=true
```

john_runtime: suggested a follow-up to add a smooth backoff instead of immediate disable — for now temp off to stop OOM.

lia: CS message drafted and posted to #customer-comm: "We're investigating intermittent 502s caused by memory pressure from extremely long prompts. We've deployed mitigations; ongoing monitoring. Will follow up with RCA." :thumbsup:

maya: handoff to eng-runtime for postmortem and long-term fix. sam and john, please own RCA. I'll update incident status and close once evictions stable for 30m.

sam: will dig into why kv eviction lagged — hypothesis: eviction scheduling throttled by batch processing; also kernel-level memory fragmentation on long-lived hosts.

john_runtime: adding tasks: 1) de-risk prefetch heuristics (add tokens-based gate), 2) make prefetch eviction-aware, 3) add circuit-breaker to avoid batch size blowups when avg sequence length > X.

lia: OPS note: downstream dashboards to update - add alert for kv_map_size growth rate > 20%/min and batch.max_inflight > 1024.

maya: last checks: hosts stable, OOMs stopped after rollout. Will keep the thread open for 45m and then escalate to postmortem channel. Thanks everyone.

sam: signed up for RCA. tagging follow-ups: ENG-RUNTIME-1234 (prefetch heuristics), ENG-OPS-5678 (alert tuning), PERF-91011 (batch scheduler safeguard).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, KB: temporary config rollback + prefetch caps. Monitor until 2026-03-15T03:00Z for full stabilization.

maya: closing handoff: @lia please confirm CS update posted once stable for 30m. I'll close thread after final confirmation.

lia: will do. confirmed customers notified.

maya: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
